accent-blue.note: The single secondary color — links, focus, selection, drop targets. Never a button fill.

violet-base.note: Gradient spotlight family anchor; the built app ships the violet variant only.

magenta-base.note: Gradient spotlight family anchor; unused in the built app.

orange-base.note: Gradient spotlight family anchor; unused in the built app.

coral-base.note: Gradient spotlight family anchor; unused in the built app.

display.purpose: Mona Sans Variable 500 (GT Walsheim substitute) — page titles, empty-state headings, the 62px login hero. Never labels or buttons.

body.purpose: Inter Variable 400 — default body, file names, descriptions, control text. Carries OpenType variants cv01 cv05 cv09 cv11 ss03 ss07 dlig.

label.purpose: Inter Variable 500 — table headers, quota readouts, captions, footer links, eyebrows (13px, -0.13px).

button.purpose: Inter Variable 500, 14px, lh 1.0, -0.14px — pill CTA text, no uppercase transform.

shadows.name: light-edge
shadows.purpose: Floating cards, upload queue, menus, hovered grid cards.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Focused inputs — same surface, blue ring, no surface change.

shadows.name: drop-target
shadows.purpose: Drag-over ring on the file area; pointer-inert overlay.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: State feedback for hover, focus, selection, action reveal — quick and quiet, never choreographed page-load sequences.

motion.name: pressed-scale
motion.purpose: Pills shrink on press; no darkened fills. Icon buttons pulse their glyph instead.

motion.name: spring-system
motion.purpose: Existing springs and DialogTransition APIs drive dialog/queue entry; no new motion library.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: state changes become opacity-only, no transforms, springs, or slides.

breakpoints.name: rail-collapse
breakpoints.purpose: Fixed 240px side rail becomes app bar + temporary drawer; table/grid collapse to full-width cards with all actions always visible. Contractual — never moved.

breakpoints.name: grid-collapse
breakpoints.purpose: Entry grid collapses to full-width cards below 810px; the list/grid view toggle is desktop-only.

breakpoints.name: narrow-queue
breakpoints.purpose: Upload queue must not cover the viewport edge — maxWidth calc(100vw - 16px), left 8 fallback, safe-area-aware bottom padding.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary CTA — white pill, canvas text, pressed scale(0.97).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #FFFFFF; color: #0E0E10; padding: 10px 15px; border-radius: 100px; border: none; font: 500 14px/1.0 'Inter Variable'; letter-spacing: -0.14px; transition: transform 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(0,153,255,0.55); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Charcoal pill — surface-1 fill, ink text, hairline border; hover lifts to surface-2.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #1A1A1D; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 10px 15px; border-radius: 100px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); font: 500 14px/1.0 'Inter Variable'; letter-spacing: -0.14px; transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #242428; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form fields — surface-1 fill, hairline border, blue focus ring, ink-muted placeholder.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #1A1A1D; color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 14px; font: 400 15px/1.3 'Inter Variable'; letter-spacing: -0.15px; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #999999; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,153,255,0.15); border-color: rgba(0,153,255,0.15); }

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Surface-2 panel, 20px radius, light-edge-strong, 24px padding, rgba(0,0,0,0.72) backdrop; headline tier title.
components.html:
New folder

Folders can contain files and other folders.
components.css: .ds-dialog { background: #242428; border-radius: 20px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.12), 0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-dialog h3 { font: 700 22px/1.2 'Inter Variable'; letter-spacing: -0.8px; margin: 0 0 16px; }

components.name: Selection Bar
components.description: Floating surface-2 bar over the manifest, 20px radius, light-edge-strong; count in caption/ink, actions as small charcoal pills.
components.css: .ds-selection { position: fixed; background: #242428; border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.12), 0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); padding: 8px 12px; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-selection span { font: 500 13px/1.2 'Inter Variable'; color: #999999; }

components.name: Entry Table Row
components.description: Manifest row — canvas surface, surface-1 hover, surface-2 selected, hairline-soft dividers; actions reveal on hover (desktop).
components.css: .ds-row { cursor: pointer; } .ds-row td { padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); color: #FFFFFF; font: 400 15px/1.3 'Inter Variable'; letter-spacing: -0.15px; } .ds-row:hover { background: #1A1A1D; } .ds-row.selected { background: #242428; }

components.name: Entry Grid Tile
components.description: File tile — icon cell, name, meta; surface-1, 15px radius; hover lifts to surface-2 + light-edge.
components.css: .ds-tile { background: #1A1A1D; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 15px; padding: 10px; color: #FFFFFF; transition: background-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-tile:hover { background: #242428; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.10), 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); } .ds-tile span:last-child { color: #999999; }

components.name: Entry Cards
components.description: Same tile grammar stacked for touch; all actions always visible below 768px (no hover dependency).
components.css: .ds-card { background: #1A1A1D; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 15px; padding: 15px; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-card span:last-child { color: #999999; }

components.name: Spotlight Card
components.description: The one gradient card: violet linear-gradient(140deg, #5B21B6, #7C3AED 48%, #A78BFA), 30px radius, 40px padding, centered; frosted translucent pill CTA. Appears exactly once — the drive empty state.
components.html:
Your space is ready

Your files are encrypted before they're stored — only you can see them.
components.css: .ds-spotlight { background: linear-gradient(140deg, #5B21B6 0%, #7C3AED 48%, #A78BFA 100%); border-radius: 30px; padding: 40px; text-align: center; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-spotlight h2 { font: 500 32px/1.13 'Mona Sans Variable'; letter-spacing: -1.0px; margin: 15px 0 5px; } .ds-spotlight button { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); color: #FFFFFF; border: none; border-radius: 100px; padding: 10px 15px; font: 500 14px/1.0 'Inter Variable'; }

components.name: Upload Queue
components.description: Floating bottom-right surface-2 panel, 20px radius, light-edge; 6px white progress bar on white-10% track; done = success-green check glyph; safe-area aware and clamped below 412px.
components.css: .ds-queue { position: fixed; right: 16px; bottom: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); background: #242428; border-radius: 20px; width: 380px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.10), 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); color: #FFFFFF; } @media (max-width: 412px) { .ds-queue { max-width: calc(100vw - 16px); left: 8px; right: 8px; } }

components.name: Drop Zone
components.description: Drag-over state — blue dashed ring with rgba(0,153,255,0.06) fill; pointer-inert overlay over the file area.
components.css: .ds-drop { border: 2px dashed #0099FF; background: rgba(0,153,255,0.06); border-radius: 20px; pointer-events: none; color: #FFFFFF; }

narrative.overview: Wyvern Drive is a personal cloud drive backed by Discord — files split into chunks, AES-256-GCM encrypted at rest, served from one per-user Discord webhook — and it wears Framer's dark-canvas world: a near-black canvas, oversized white display type with hard negative tracking, and one chromatic accent (blue) reserved for links, focus, and selection, never a fill. The app is a poster at the edges (login, share links) and a quiet instrument in the middle (the drive itself), where scanability, density, and familiar cloud-drive idioms outrank expression. Hierarchy is carried by surface lift — canvas #0E0E10 → surface-1 #1A1A1D → surface-2 #242428 — and the text scale is binary ink #FFFFFF / ink-muted #999999. The only chromatic depth in the whole system is the scarce gradient spotlight card (the drive's empty state), the memorable moment that sits in an otherwise monochrome grid like a Framer showcase tile. The category default it refuses: the light Google-Drive chrome of every other file manager.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black canvas everywhere; no light mode, no white cards, no light interludes
Hard negative display tracking (Mona Sans at 500, -3.1px at 62px, -1.0px at 32px) for poster-grade headlines
White pill is the only primary CTA; charcoal pills and text links cover everything else
One gradient spotlight card (violet, 30px radius) as the system's only atmosphere device — the drive empty state
Inter Variable body with bespoke OpenType variants (cv01 cv05 cv09 cv11 ss03 ss07 dlig)
5px spacing base (5/10/15/20/30/40); radius from 4px chips to 100px pills, 15–20px cards, 30px spotlight
Cloud-drive side rail (user-confirmed over a marketing top nav); monochrome file-type glyphs (folders ink, files ink-muted)
Light-edge elevation: an inset white top edge over a deep drop shadow — the only shadow language
Poster at the edges (login, share), quiet instrument in the middle (drive, Operate-first)
Accent blue #0099FF is the single secondary color — links, focus, selection, drop targets; never a fill

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Accent blue #0099FF is reserved for links, focus, and selection. If you reach for a second blue — or a blue button fill — the brand is drifting.

rules.name: The Binary Ink Rule
rules.body: Secondary type is ink-muted #999999 or it is ink #FFFFFF. No mid-tone grays, no opacity gradients on white type.

rules.name: The Lift Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy on dark is marked by surface lift (canvas → surface-1 → surface-2), never by color or brightness of type. Selected = one step up, never a tint.

rules.name: The Gradient-Is-Cards Rule
rules.body: Gradients belong to the spotlight card alone. A gradient on a whole section, a button, or a background is a drift; gradients are cards.

dos: Keep canvas and ink as the two anchor surfaces; every band chooses one or the other.
Push display tracking hard negative and keep the Inter OpenType variants on.
Use blue only for links, focus, selection — and the drop-target ring.
Mark hierarchy with surface lift; selected = one step up, never a tint.
Compose every CTA as a pill and every icon action as a circle.
Keep the gradient scarce — one spotlight card, ever.
Show the task and the primary action in the first viewport on every route.
donts: Ship a light surface anywhere. The brand is dark.
Make the blue a brand fill — no blue pills, no blue logo tiles.
Square off CTAs or use bordered ghost buttons with transparent fills.
Reduce display negative tracking "for accessibility" — reduce size, keep the percentage.
Apply gradients to whole sections; gradients are cards.
Color-code file types; the glyph carries the type, folders are ink and files are ink-muted.
